title: Mailbox read succeeds and issues a receipt, then ACK and a fresh read return 404 "mailbox not found for this participant" for the same caller
outcome: Mailbox read succeeds and issues a receipt, then ACK and a fresh read return 404 "mailbox not found for this participant" for the same caller
acceptance: The cause is identified from source and host evidence: why a participant that list shows, and that just read the mailbox, is not found as a native member for ack and later reads.

A participant that can read a mailbox can acknowledge the receipt it was issued and read again, covered by a behaviour test of the read, ack and read sequence for the membership shape that failed here; a non-member is still refused.
